title: PTNK Candidate Knowledge Atom
description: Schema for reviewable candidate knowledge atoms. This is distinct from the official promoted knowledge-atom schema; candidate fields preserve source analysis, evidence, context, interpretation, and human-review metadata.

atom_type.description: Proposed type of knowledge represented by the candidate.

part_of_speech.description: Source-stated or context-supported part of speech; preserve the field even when unavailable.

sense.description: Proposed sense/meaning description. Preserve the field even when the source instead supplies a definition.

definition.description: Source-provided definition, preserved verbatim when available. Retained for candidates that use definition rather than sense.

mother_says.description: Learner-facing Vietnamese meaning of the proposed verified sense. Explanatory wording beyond the concise equivalent goes in parentheses. Leave blank when not established; never guess.

patterns.description: Verified or strongly context-supported usage patterns associated with the proposed sense. Keep the field even when none is established; use an empty array rather than guessing.

usage_note.description: Verified or strongly context-supported usage restriction, register, nuance, contrast, or other important usage note. Leave blank when not established; do not guess.

source_status.description: Status of the candidate's substantive claim relative to the source, such as source-stated or inferred.

source_example.description: Source example supporting the proposed sense. Leave blank when unavailable; do not invent source evidence.
